## Findings

I checked the plan-quota table, the feature-flag percentage-rollout strategy, the rate-limiter bucket config, and the error-code mapping against the code that implements each, and found contradictions in four places:

**1. Plan quotas** — `docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md` (REQ-134) states "3 projects on free, 10 on starter, 100 on growth." The actual table in `src/config/plan-limits.ts` has `free.projects = 2` (3 is the free `seats` value, not `projects`). Every other document that restates the ladder (ADR-010, the 2026-02-10 pricing notes, the table in `docs/api/actions-billing.md`) gets it right as 2 — only this one requirement transposes the numbers.

**2. Percentage rollout** — `docs/requirements/feature-flags.md` (REQ-189) asserts the `ai_issue_summary` percentage strategy "hashes the organization's id (**not** the acting user's)" and that "the rollout decision does not depend on the acting user, only the organization." The actual `bucketOf()` in `src/lib/feature-flags.ts` hashes `` `${flag}:${ctx.orgId}:${ctx.userId}` `` — the user id is part of the seed, so two members of the same org can land in different buckets, contradicting the "every member sees the same on/off state" claim.

**3. Refill-rate / rate-limiter keying** — `docs/adr/ADR-011-in-process-rate-limiter.md` and `docs/ops/notes-2026-01-30-rate-limiter-sizing.md` both state that `auth:password-reset` "is charged per identity (email address attempted) rather than per organization." In the actual code (`src/server/services/auth-service.ts`, `src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts`), every anonymous call passes a fixed sentinel `ANONYMOUS_ORG_ID`/`ANONYMOUS_ORG` constant — the bucket is one shared global counter, not scoped per email at all.

**4. Error codes an action can actually return** — `docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md` (DES-222) claims the action-layer error classes (`PlanLimitError`, `RateLimitedError`, `ForbiddenActionError`, etc.) "are recognized through their own `readonly code` field being read directly ... or through structural equivalence." In `src/lib/errors.ts`, `toAppError()`/`isDomainError()` only do `instanceof` checks against six service-layer classes and never reference `action-errors.ts` at all — every action-layer error class (and even the plain `Error` thrown by `assertWithinLimit` in `billing-service.ts`, contradicting REQ-138 in `billing-and-plan-limits.md`) falls through to `internal_error`/500 instead of its documented code.

ANSWER: docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md, docs/requirements/feature-flags.md, docs/adr/ADR-011-in-process-rate-limiter.md, docs/ops/notes-2026-01-30-rate-limiter-sizing.md, docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md
